notes:
- **fix: invoice from job tasks — job link not prepopulated** — `invoice_job_work_tasks()` now passes `job_id` in `inv_data`; `save_invoice()` updated to include `job_id` in both INSERT and UPDATE so the invoice opens pre-linked to the originating job. (`core/jobs.py`, `core/ledger.py`)
- **fix: emailing an approved invoice now auto-advances to Sent** — `api_invoice_email` calls `mark_invoice_sent()` after a successful send when the invoice status is Approved; Draft and already-Sent invoices are unaffected. (`web/routes/invoices.py`)
- **fix: EOFY preflight — unreconciled bank count excluded rejected journal lines** — `eofy_status()` counted all journal lines with `is_reconciled=0` including those marked `is_rejected=1` (bank rec "Reject Dup" entries); added `AND (jl.is_rejected IS NULL OR jl.is_rejected = 0)` to the query so only genuinely unreconciled lines are flagged. (`core/ledger.py`)
- **feat: EOFY rollover — backup warning banner** — Settings › EOFY Rollover now fetches `/api/backup/status` in parallel and displays a red warning banner above the Roll Over button if no backup exists or the last backup is >7 days old, with a link to Backup Settings. (`web/static/js/settings.js`)
- **feat: credit card accounts in bill payment modal** — bill payment "From Account" dropdown now groups Bank Accounts and Credit Cards into separate optgroups, so credit card accounts can be used to pay supplier bills. (`web/static/js/bills.js`)

- **fix: Linkly recovery — declined transactions now surfaced** — recovery modal on startup previously only handled `status === 'completed'`; extended to also show a red "Transaction Failed — Recovery" modal for `status === 'declined'`. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: Linkly recovery — TxnRef (tx_id) now included in recovery response** — `recover_linkly_startup()` extracts `TxnRef`/`txnRef` from the Linkly GET response and returns it as `tx_id`; previously the Print Receipt button sent an empty TXN Ref. (`core/pos.py`)
- **fix: Linkly recovery — Print Receipt button onclick attribute JSON bug** — `JSON.stringify(res)` inline in an onclick attribute broke the attribute when the object contained double quotes; fixed by storing data in `window._posRecoverData` and referencing that instead. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: Linkly recovery — browser print uses hidden iframe instead of window.open** — Chromium app-mode popup blocker prevents `window.open()` after any `await`; replaced with hidden iframe `contentWindow.print()` which is not subject to popup blocking. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **chore: Linkly accreditation — section 3.1 test evidence corrected** — 3.1.1 updated to show direct `GET` to Linkly Cloud API (`rest.pos.sandbox.cloud.pceftpos.com`) using the 2.1.1 approved session (was incorrectly showing the dbox localhost wrapper endpoint); 3.1.2 confirmed correct (unchanged); 3.1.3 completed live via Python script — HTTP 202 with empty body captured while PINpad was processing, transaction cancelled cleanly. (`tests/Linkly-Cloud-Accreditation-2026.xlsx`)
- **chore: Linkly Cloud Accreditation 2026 spreadsheet finalised** — all mandatory tests documented: 1.x (basic purchase/refund/settlement), 2.1.1–2.2.1 (referral/signature), 3.1.1–3.1.2 (power-fail recovery — approved and declined), 4.1.1–4.1.3 (power-fail mid-transaction), 6.1.1 (settlement). Screenshots embedded. (`tests/Linkly-Cloud-Accreditation-2026.xlsx`)

- **fix: Dogbox Investments installer** — end-to-end Windows install now working: dinv.zip packaged in dbox-releases (was downloading from private repo → 404); watchlist nav module registered; desktop shortcut uses pythonw.exe resolved from pip-installed Python (avoids Windows Store stub and py.exe version mismatch); pip bootstrapped via ensurepip if missing; startup errors logged to startup.log. (`dbox-releases`, `dbox-investments`)

- **refactor: contacts/jobs tasks — one task classification** — removed separate CRM "Linked tasks" section from contacts task tab; both contacts and jobs now show a single unified work-task list. CRM task fetch dropped from contacts loader; tab open-count badge reflects work tasks only. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **refactor: contacts tasks — "+ Add Task" button pattern** — replaced always-visible inline add form with a modal triggered by a button at the top of the list, matching the jobs tab UX. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **refactor: jobs tasks — one task classification** — `_jobTabTasks` simplified to work tasks only; no `_kind` branching, priority badge, or "$ Bill" button. `_jobAddTask` now opens a work-task modal (title, description, qty/price, dates, recurring). `_jobCompleteTask` and `_jobDelTask` drop the `kind` parameter. Tab count reflects work tasks only. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **fix: contacts task date filter loses focus on keypress** — split `_renderTaskLog` into a shell render (written once) and `_refreshTaskRows` (updates only `#wt-tbody` and `#wt-count-row`); date inputs are never destroyed when filters change, so focus is preserved. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **fix: horizontal scrollbar locked to bottom of visible area** — `.wt-wrap .tbl-overflow-x` gets `max-height: 52vh; overflow: auto` so the scrollbar is always at the bottom of the visible table box. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: date input year capped at 4 digits** — MutationObserver in dashboard.html stamps `max="9999-12-31"` on every `<input type="date">` as it enters the DOM; Chrome advances from year to month after 4 digits. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **fix: date inputs display dd/mm/yyyy** — all HTML templates updated to `lang="en-AU"`; Chrome uses the page lang attribute to determine date picker display format. (`web/templates/*.html`)

- **feat: FY2026-27 tax tables** — ATO Schedule 1 coefficient tables updated for 1 July 2026: 16% first-band rate drops to 15%; both 2025-26 and 2026-27 table sets coexist in code; selection is automatic via `fy_year` — pay runs before 1 July use old tables, on or after use new ones. Source: ATO NAT 1004 published 17 June 2026. (`core/payroll.py`)
- **feat: Medicare levy thresholds 2026-27** — no-levy threshold raised to $28,011 (from $21,778); full 2% levy from $35,013 (from $27,222). Source: Treasury Laws Amendment (More Cost of Living Relief) Act 2025. (`core/database.py`)

- **fix: Linkly decline message** — `_LINKLY_DECLINE_MSGS` maps known codes (TO, 51, 54, 55, 91, 92) to friendly text; all-caps `ResponseText` (e.g. "SYSTEM ERROR") replaced with "Declined". (`core/pos.py`)
- **fix: POS refund terminal amount includes GST** — terminal refund was sending ex-GST unit price (e.g. $9.09 vs $10.00 charged); `refundTotal` now multiplies by 1.1 for GST lines. Refund modal line amounts and total also updated to show GST-inclusive. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: Linkly accreditation — unique TxnRef per transaction** — purchase `TxnRef` now uses `idempotency_key.replace('-','')[:16]` (UUID-derived, unique per transaction) instead of the static "POS" string. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Linkly accreditation — recovery receipt printing** — recovery modal on startup now shows TXN Ref and a "Print Receipt" button; `print_recovery_receipt()` prints an ESC/POS slip (status, amount, TXN ref, RFN, timestamp); `POST /api/pos/terminal/print-recovery` route added. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: Linkly — camelCase response parsing** — sandbox returns camelCase JSON (`response`, `success`, `responseCode`, `purchaseAnalysisData`); added `_linkly_get(d, *keys)` helper and updated all response parsing to try both cases. (`core/pos.py`)
- **fix: Linkly — posId UUID validation** — `device_id` values stored as non-UUID strings are now converted to a stable UUID via `uuid5` before pairing, preventing HTTP 400 from the Linkly auth server. (`core/pos.py`)
- **fix: Linkly — refund proceeds without RFN** — sandbox purchases don't return an RFN; refund no longer hard-errors on missing RFN; omits RFN from `PurchaseAnalysisData` when not available. Production sales with a stored RFN continue to include it. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: POS — two-phase card terminal message** — "Connecting to terminal…" for 2.5 s, then switches to "Present card on terminal / Tap, insert or swipe". `clearTimeout` in both success and error paths. Applied to single and split card flows. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: POS — "End Day" replaces "Z-Report"** — button renamed; modal title "End of Day" (live preview) / "Day Report" (closed); sessions list button "Day Report". (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: POS — Staff Change quick-close** — second button in End Day modal; closes session without cash count or banking and immediately shows the Open Register form (for staff changeover mid-day). (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: POS — settlement integrated into End of Day close** — Banking step shows "Settle terminal after close" checkbox (ON by default, Linkly only); runs automatically after session close; result shown in Day Report footer. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: POS — EFTPOS clearing journal at session close** — `close_pos_session()` now posts DR Main Bank / CR EFTPOS Clearing for the card total when a banking account is configured. Runs alongside the existing cash banking journal. (`core/pos.py`)

- **feat: Persistent LAN config** — `dbox.conf` JSON file at app root persists LAN mode so users don't need `--lan` flag after initial setup. `web_server.py` reads conf on startup; CLI `--lan` writes conf automatically. Settings → Server → LAN Mode section: status badge (active IP / inactive), toggle checkbox, Save & Restart flow with auto-reload poller. `GET /POST /api/system/server-config` added with licence validation. (`web_server.py`, `web/routes/system.py`, `web/static/js/settings.js`)
- **feat: Tablet PWA — table service / POS** — standalone `/tablet` SPA installable as a PWA on iOS and Android via LAN. Includes touch-optimised floor plan (zone tabs, colour-coded table tiles, elapsed timers), tab/order view (item grid with category filter + search, qty stepper, fire-kitchen with manual-confirm fallback, settle modal for cash/card/account), takeaway queue with new-order modal. All UI calls existing `/api/ts/*` and `/api/pos/items` endpoints — no new business logic. (`web/routes/tablet.py`, `web/templates/tablet.html`, `web/templates/tablet_login.html`, `web/static/js/tablet.js`, `web/static/tablet.css`, `web/static/manifest.json`, `web/static/sw.js`, `web/static/img/tablet-icon-192.png`, `web/static/img/tablet-icon-512.png`, `web/server.py`, `web/templates/dashboard.html`)

- **feat: Bill of Materials for Jobs** — Materials tab in job detail panel; CRUD for `job_bom_lines` (description, qty, unit cost/price, notes); status badges: Pending / Ordered / On Hand / Client Supplied; PO link/unlink; on-hand toggle; totals cards (Our Cost, Billable, Margin, Client-supplied count). (`core/jobs.py`, `core/database.py`, `web/routes/jobs.py`, `web/static/js/jobs.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Create PO from BOM** — "→ Create PO" button on Materials tab; supplier picker; server creates PO and links `po_id` back to selected BOM lines. (`core/purchase_orders.py`, `web/routes/jobs.py`, `web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **feat: From BOM in PO edit form** — "↓ From BOM" button on PO form when a job is selected; checkbox picker for unordered BOM lines; injected as PO line rows; BOM lines auto-linked after PO save. (`web/static/js/purchase_orders.js`)
- **feat: Print BOM PDF** — A4 portrait, company theme, trimmed 6-column layout (desc 55mm, qty 14mm, cost 20mm, price 20mm, PO 25mm, status ~40mm), totals block. (`core/bom_pdf.py`)
- **feat: Linkly accreditation — exponential backoff on 408/5xx** — `_get_linkly_status` recovery GET retries up to 6 times with 1→64s exponential back-off on request-timeout and server-error responses. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Linkly accreditation — Signature Required ("08") handling** — `_linkly_store_result` unified parser treats ResponseCode "08" as completed; `_posPollTerminal` shows a signature verify dialog (Decline / Confirm Signature) before submitting the sale; RFN captured from response and included in sale record. (`core/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Linkly accreditation — terminal refund flow** — `refund_linkly_terminal()` looks up the RFN stored from the original purchase and issues a TxnType "R" reversal to the terminal. `terminal_provider` and `terminal_rfn` are now stored in `pos_sales` (both single and split tender paths) and `terminal_provider` is returned by `get_pos_sales`. History Refund button passes `terminal_provider` through; `_posRefundConfirm` contacts the terminal before posting the accounting credit note for Linkly card sales. `POST /api/pos/terminal/refund` route added. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Linkly accreditation — power-fail recovery** — `linkly_last_session` column added to `pos_settings`; `_linkly_save_last_session` / `_linkly_clear_last_session` persist the in-flight session ID (written before the charge, cleared in `finally`). `recover_linkly_startup()` reads the stored ID on app startup, does a recovery GET with exponential backoff, and returns the resolved transaction. `GET /api/pos/terminal/recover` route added. `pagePos()` fires the recovery call for Linkly and shows a modal with amount and RFN if a completed transaction is found. (`core/pos.py`, `core/pos_settings.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **chore: Linkly accreditation spreadsheet added to tests/** — reference copy of accreditation test matrix. (`tests/Linkly-Cloud-Accreditation-2026.xlsx`)
